name: fig04b-executable-alt
description: Alternate executable compilation of fig04b-cellular-interface: the SAME typed cellular-interface contract realized by a SECOND, independent handler (CooperativeCellularInterfaceHandler) with a different internal mechanism — a saturable Michaelis-Menten membrane-carrier uptake, an independent cooperative (Moser/Hill, n>1) growth law, and Q10 thermal death — behind byte-identical cell ports, where the Monod twin uses first-order uptake, Monod growth, and Arrhenius death. Fitted so the interface observables track the fig04b-executable across the operating range chem in [0.2,2.5] to within ~10%. Runnable.
